title: Ember/Chromatic Migration, Gallery, Assignment & Persistence
objective: Migrate the existing Ember and Chromatic compatibility identities into the canonical Skin Pack runtime without semantic, layout, interaction, accessibility or reading-assistance regression, and implement bounded gallery/preview/apply/assignment/persistence/hot-switch/recovery behavior over the completed UISR-01..05 foundations.

included: preserve existing ember and chromatic identities as selectable compatibility aliases with no mandatory winner
route legacy theme IDs and persisted compatible values through canonical Skin Pack registry identities
preserve existing semantic component behavior, protected status meaning, shared layout/interaction semantics, accessibility and application-wide reading preferences with no skin-specific React forks
Skin Gallery and deterministic/current-screen preview with textual identity, compatibility and availability status
explicit Apply/assignment scopes and persistence using governed precedence and safe recovery/fallback
atomic hot switching while preserving focus, viewport/task state and reading/accessibility preferences
unavailable or incompatible pack visibility with plain-language reason and Apply disabled
focused UISR-06 tests and exact-head Linux/Windows deterministic validation
excluded: materializing the structural stress-test target packs reserved for UISR-07
environmental/genre and extreme/social/craft target pack materialization reserved for UISR-08 and UISR-09
Tier-C release packaging, measured performance proof and destructive legacy cleanup reserved for UISR-10
gameplay, permission, hidden-information, navigation, validation, provenance or AI authority
scope.completion_gate: Ember and Chromatic resolve through the canonical Skin Pack registry with behavioral/accessibility parity, and gallery/preview/apply/assignment/persistence/hot-switch/recovery operate safely through declarative runtime state without granting presentation new application authority.

selection_boundaries: UISR-06 is selected by verified UISR-05 closeout but has no implementation authority until a later owner Continue.
Legacy IDs/storage may remain compatibility aliases during migration; migration must not invent a mandatory default winner or fork feature components by skin.
The ui-implementation lane remains parallel to product-development and may not pause or rewrite product work.
Publication to Multiversal-app main remains serialized by the OPS3 merge lease and requires fresh-base reconciliation if another lane publishes first.
next_action: On owner Continue, fresh-read UISK-11 migration/baseline, UISK-15 registry/assignment/gallery/persistence/hot-switch, and UISK-16 legacy migration/obsolete-path contracts; reconcile the then-current application base; govern-start UISR-06; establish causal RED; implement through exact-head cross-platform validation, serialized publication and lane-local closeout.
